entities.name: Threat
entities.description: A large gray cat of Kaldheim, communal pet of the Jutmaw longhall.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: Planeswalker who played with Threat using conjured mirrors.

entities.name: Kjell
entities.description: Companion who joins Niko and Birgi.

entities.name: Jutmaw
entities.description: Location with a longhall of warriors and sailors.

events.summary: Niko notices Threat under the tables in the Jutmaw longhall and entertains her with conjured mirrors.
events.quote: Niko entertained the cat by conjuring small, reflective mirrors

events.summary: Niko's magic recalls the mirror Threat holds, shattering it; Threat looks betrayed.
Birgi joins Niko and Kjell and calls Threat, who comes mewing to her.
events.quote: she called out to Threat, who came mewing to her

relations.quote: Birgi says Threat belonged to the longhall itself
